description: Dated decisions tied to a subdivision, heading or heading pattern. The analyzer attaches a note to the facts when the string under test uses that subdivision, heading or pattern; the model reports it as LC practice, not as an SHM rule.

LC form subdivisions are often broad. The proposed subdivision --Graphic novels was not established; the broader --Comic books, strips, etc. covers graphic novels on specific topics.
--Teacher training is used only in the field of religious education. For teachers in other fields use --Training of under the heading for the class of teachers.

Added to the free-floating list for organs of the body: --Cross-sectional imaging (May Subd Geog).

Headings of the type [disease] in [type of animal] are made only for conditions generally regarded as animal diseases. For conditions common to humans and animals, use [disease] in animals plus [type of animal]--Diseases, e.g. Obesity in animals with Horses--Diseases.
--In art, --In literature, and --In motion pictures are free-floating under geographic headings tagged 151, so Polar regions in art and similar headings need not be established.

Because Zanzibar is part of Tanzania, literature of Zanzibar is expressed as Tanzanian literature--Tanzania--Zanzibar (and similarly for the English-language and wit and humor headings), not as a Zanzibari literature heading.
Added to the free-floating list for places: --Kings and rulers--Deposition.

Policy change: Caribbean islands south of the Virgin Islands are no longer assigned directly after subjects. Islands independent as countries (Dominica, Martinique) are assigned directly; islands that are part of a multi-island country (Bonaire, Curacao) are assigned indirectly through the country, e.g. Marine algae--Netherlands Antilles--Bonaire. Features on those islands are likewise indirect through the country. Qualifiers for such features use the larger jurisdiction, not the island.

Comic books or strips on a particular topic are expressed with free-floating --Comic books, strips, etc. after the topical heading, e.g. War--Comic books, strips, etc. Spy and War comic books headings were not approved; form headings for comic books stay limited to existing fictional genres.

Specific headings for conditions in groups of people exist only for general age and sex groups (children, women). For other groups assign the condition heading plus the group heading with a subdivision such as --Diseases or --Physiology, e.g. Weight loss with Nursing home patients--Diseases.

--Effect of [...] on is not extended beyond existing patterns (plants, animals, materials, body parts, some business topics). Wetlands--Effect of grazing on was refused; assign Grazing--Environmental aspects with the geographic area heading.

LC does not use --Comic books, strips, etc. under form headings, and makes no distinction between fictional and nonfiction comic books and strips. UF references from Science fiction--Comic books, strips, etc. and similar strings were refused.
Subgenres of love stories based on character attributes were not approved. Love stories featuring a class of characters may get an added entry for the class of persons with --Fiction.
--Taxation--Law and legislation was authorized for free-floating use under topical headings (WL02-47), so Farm corporations--Taxation--Law and legislation needs no proposal.
Added to the free-floating list for materials: --Fires and fire prevention (May Subd Geog).

Electric violoncello with orchestra can be constructed without an authority record once Electric violoncello and Electric violoncello music exist. A music heading is required as a companion to a new instrument heading (H 1918).
The plural form peoples is not used in qualifiers for LCSH headings; Yawarawarga (Australian peoples) was changed to (Australian people).
Concertos (Maracas) and Concertos (Steel drum) can be constructed without subject authority records.
A subdivision --Antiquities, Armenian was not created; the concept is covered by free-floating Armenians--[place]--Antiquities and Armenia--Antiquities.
Headings of the type [place]--Flood, [date] were discontinued in 1985 in favor of Floods--[place]. Netherlands--Flood, 1570 was cancelled and Netherlands--Flood, 1953 was not approved.
Added to the free-floating list for places: --Kings and rulers--Assassination.

The free-floating subdivision --Sexual behavior now carries (May Subd Geog) on the lists for classes of persons, ethnic groups, and animals.

Added to the free-floating lists for individual schools and types of schools: --Professional staff.
Quotation headings are qualified by language but not by nationality (except American quotations). Quotations from the Philippines in English are expressed as Quotations, English--Philippines.

Headings for fictitious characters take only subdivisions widely used under topical headings, such as --Exhibitions or --Fiction, not subdivisions restricted to real persons or groups. Simpsons (Fictitious characters)--Homes and haunts was refused.
New free-floating --Simulation games, used under topical headings.

Added --Deterioration (May Subd Geog) to the free-floating lists for general subjects and materials.

--Seeds--Anatomy was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.

--Mortality (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1100, H 1103, H 1147 and H 1150 lists.

--Gays remains valid under individual military services (e.g. United States. Army--Gays) but not under Armed Forces, [place]--Armed Forces or Multinational armed forces; assign Gays in the military (May Subd Geog) instead.

Fishes--Effect of insecticides on--Monitoring was not approved; use the two existing headings Fishes--Monitoring and Fishes--Effect of insecticides on.

National-adjective qualifiers on Radio broadcasting are for broadcasting from a country to outside or to expatriates; broadcasting within a country uses geographic subdivision (Radio broadcasting--South Africa).
--Age determination (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.

--Size (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.

--Censures was added to the H 1110 list for individual persons.

Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Nomenclature (Popular)--French, [Italian, etc.].

Adjectival qualifiers for jurisdictions or regions are not used with classes of persons (H 350 sec. 1); a work on Greeks in Egypt takes Businesspeople--Greece, Businesspeople--Egypt and Greeks--Egypt instead of Businesspeople, Greek.
Japan--Foreign relations--21st century was not needed for a work covering only the first twelve years of the century; the existing Japan--Foreign relations--1989- suffices.
Added to the Animals list (H 1147): --Disease resistance (May Subd Geog).
Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Effect of sediments on (May Subd Geog).
To authorize --Dropouts under the Diseases pattern, the pattern heading Cancer--Treatment--Dropouts should be proposed (see H 1150) rather than Therapeutics--Dropouts.

--In bookplates is not made free-floating because it has been needed only once in a hundred years; the lone 'in bookplates' phrase heading is replaced by an individually established Don Quixote (Fictitious character)--In bookplates.

LC will not create class-of-persons headings that combine a religion and a national or ethnic adjective with 'authors' (Jewish authors, Iraqi was refused); geographic subdivision brings out place. Jewish authors, Oriental became Mizrahi authors and Jewish novelists, Oriental became Mizrahi novelists, both subdividable geographically for current location or place of origin.
Under [place]--Politics and government use the free-floating century subdivision (--Politics and government--19th century) rather than a new span such as 1832-1886, per H 1942 sec. 2.b.

Pre-retirees was refused; the free-floating combination Employees--Retirement and the subdivision --Employees--Retirement (used under industries, services, establishments, individual persons, and individual educational institutions and non-governmental corporate bodies) can be used with Older people.
Added to the Literatures list (H 1156): --Garifuna authors.
Added to the Land vehicles list (H 1195): --Motors--Exhaust manifolds.
Added to the Animals list (H 1147): --Phenology (May Subd Geog).
Tombs and mausoleums of individual families are assigned the family heading subdivided by --Tombs rather than given their own heading.
LCSH does not establish headings for individual named tours; works on a tour take [place]--Tours, sometimes with a heading for the type of tour.

--Fluid dynamics is not set as a subdivision under headings for individual parts of automobile motors (e.g. Exhaust manifolds) as too narrow; assign Fluid dynamics separately. Precedent exists only under systems of motors (Automobiles--Motors--Exhaust systems--Fluid dynamics).
A collection of poetry by a single author may be assigned a form heading only if it is highly specific (H 1800 sec. 2.b); use LCGFT or LCDGT terms instead of Manx poetry (English).

There is no requirement that --History and --Politics and government for a place have matching chronological subdivisions; Benin--Politics and government--To 1894 was refused because the existing --To 1960 covers the period and the file is small.

--Effect of monetary policy on is established under concepts rather than individual events; Global Financial Crisis, 2008-2009--Effect of monetary policy on became Financial crises--Effect of monetary policy on, assigned with the event heading.
A collection of fiction by one author cannot be assigned a nonspecific form heading such as Short stories, [nationality] unless it has a topical aspect or a highly specific form (H 1790 sec. 2.b).

In LCSH --Communication means human communication and is free-floating under ethnic groups; LC declined to authorize it under animals and keeps postcoordinating Animal communication with [animal]--Behavior (e.g. Fishes--Communication was refused).
Cameroon--Politics and government--1960- was kept as a broad heading alongside the narrower --1960-1982 and --1982- spans, so it should not be cancelled.
Dagestanis is authorized for geographic subdivision, so Dagestanis--Kazakhstan needs no proposal.
--Ethnic relations free-floats under names of places, so Kazakhstan--Ethnic relations needs no proposal.
Biographies may be assigned a heading qualified by sex or ethnic group only if that is a significant aspect of the work, and then in addition to the unqualified group heading (H 1330 sec. 1.b).
No precedent for a heading combining nationality and ethnicity of refugees (Refugees, Sri Lankan Tamil); use Refugees--[place] and the ethnic group heading--[place] instead.
Added to the Classes of persons list (H 1100): --Crimes against--Law and legislation (May Subd Geog).
Standard LCSH practice is the free-floating subdivision --Design under Exhibitions; the direct phrase heading Exhibition design was refused.
Adjectival qualifiers representing jurisdictions or regions are not used with classes of persons (H 350 sec. 1); the correct heading is Journalists--Turkey.

[Topic] and [topic] headings are for reciprocal relationships between very general topics (H 310); for a work on media coverage use Riots--Press coverage and Terrorism--Press coverage instead of Communalism and mass media.

Request to extend the free-floating --Benefactors from individual educational institutions to all corporations (or nonprofits) was refused; add headings for types of benefactors and postcoordinate with the corporate name.
--Risk assessment has not been used under Hunting or specific types of hunting and would be ambiguous; Barren ground caribou hunting--Risk assessment was refused.

Northern Ireland--History--1969-1994 and --1994- were revised to --1968-1998 and --1998- (with the analogous Politics and government headings) to cover The Troubles; a separate Northern Ireland Conflict heading was not approved.

A new chronological span such as Pakistan--Politics and government--1947-1971 is hard to establish late because of heavy file maintenance (1,520+ records); the proposer must list the records to be revised and cite a source on the period's significance.

Single-author poetry collections are not assigned nonspecific form headings such as Saint Vincentian poetry (English) unless the heading includes a topical aspect or a highly specific form (H 1800 sec. 2.b).
General headings for years are assigned only to general works on the time period not limited to specific topics (H 620 sec. 2.c).
Request to make --Globalization free-floating under topics was refused because most concrete nouns cannot be globalized; use headings such as Education and globalization.
Added to the Literatures list (H 1156): --Northern Irish authors.

Atlases may now be assigned to all geographic atlases and subdivided geographically by place of publication; headings of the type Atlases, [nationality] were cancelled in favor of Atlases--[country]. Coverage is shown by [place]--Maps and works on atlases of a place take Atlases--[place]--History.
Brexit was refused as a heading; European Union--Great Britain (UF Brexit) was created and is used instead, alongside European Union--Membership.
Added to the Wars list (H 1200): --Deaf (May Subd Geog) and --Participation, Deaf.
--Tomb is free-floating under names of individual persons (H 1110), so a mausoleum of one person takes the person heading--Tomb (e.g. Helena, Saint, approximately 255-approximately 330--Tomb).
Sex differences in sports is expressed by the free-floating combination Sports--Sex differences, so a separate heading is not needed.
A single-author collection may not be assigned a nonspecific form heading like Zoque poetry (H 1800 sec. 2.b).
Works about dictionaries of a language take Language--Lexicography rather than Encyclopedias and dictionaries, [language], which is for the dictionaries themselves.

Chronological subdivisions under [place]--Politics and government should generally match those used under --History without intervening descriptive terms (H 1942 sec. 2.b); Montenegro--Politics and government--1878-1918 did not match the existing History span and the file is small.
--Environmental conditions is inherently historical and cannot be subdivided by --History; it will be added to the list of subdivisions that cannot be subdivided by --History in H 1647.
Added to the Names of places list (H 1140): --Environmental conditions with $y 16th century through 21st century.
National-group headings of this type may be assigned only to works about the nationality outside its native country; the citation must show where the Kosovans discussed live.
General headings for years are only for general works on the time period not limited to specific topics (H 620 sec. 2.c).
Operas--Characters is replaced by the heading Characters and characteristics in opera; for other musical forms postcoordinate Characters and characteristics in music with the form heading.

New chronological subdivisions under [place]--Social life and customs are for significant periods usually of forty years or more with sufficient material (H 2057 sec. 2); Korea (South)--Social life and customs--1960-1988 (22 years, few records) was not needed.
A holiday celebrated in many countries gets one heading that is subdivided geographically to bring out location (May Day (Labor holiday)), not a place-qualified heading like Labor Day (Philippines).
Added to the Languages list (H 1154): --Binomial.

Specific periods under [place]--Civilization and --Social life and customs are for broad periods of about forty years or more where files will be large; Korea (North)--Civilization--1948-1994 and --Social life and customs--1948-1994 were refused in favor of --20th century.
Atlases may be subdivided geographically, so no heading Atlases--[place] needs to be established merely to add a UF.
Geographic headings with directional qualifiers must be well-defined and generally recognized in English-language reference sources (H 760); Wikipedia alone was not enough.
The battle of Okinawa remains established as the geographic subdivision World War, 1939-1945--Campaigns--Japan--Okinawa Island because it comprised many discrete engagements; no change.
--Calendars is free-floating under names of corporate bodies, so use Coptic Church--Calendars instead of a heading Coptic calendar.
Added to the Languages list (H 1154): $v Conversation and phrase books (for plantation workers).
--International cooperation refers to official cooperation among countries, not cooperation among individuals from multiple countries; a heading using it for the latter should be revised.
Added to the Land vehicles list (H 1195): --Transmission devices, Continuously variable.

No precedent for --Dictionaries or --Language (or --Language--Glossaries, etc., which is for individual persons and works entered under title) under literary groups; --Dictionaries would mean dictionaries of the group itself.
A difference of under 100 years in the dates of Egypt--History--Third dynasty is what 'circa' dates are for; revising the span was change for change's sake.
Humorous recitations is not subdivided geographically; geographic provenance is brought out with additional headings such as Dutch drama (Comedy) or Monologues, Dutch.

When a date span is closed (Libya--Politics and government--1969-2011) a new open span (2011- ) must be proposed too, with bibliographic file maintenance instructions for the roughly 230 affected records.
Works on Jewish-Muslim relations take Judaism--Relations--Islam and Islam--Relations--Judaism; Muslims--Relations--Jews would split the file.
Added to the Land vehicles list (H 1195): --Motors--Mounts.
For national-adjective qualifiers LCSH does not distinguish Irish from Northern Irish; Irish [topic] or [topic], Irish is used for both.

A chronological subdivision such as Bastia (France)--History--15th century needs research showing a recognized significant period and enough material; free-floating century subdivisions (H 1647 sec. 2.b) exist for smaller places.
Arab-Israeli conflict may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used under wars, per its scope note, so Arab-Israeli conflict--Art and the conflict needed no proposal.

A new span under Spain--Social conditions (1975-2008, 2008- ) needs current sources showing a major shift in social conditions in 2008, since economic or political change does not necessarily affect social conditions (H 2055).

Multiple subdivisions (e.g. --Religious aspects--Buddhism, [Christianity, etc.]) will be cancelled starting fall 2018; propose the needed heading string (e.g. Paleography--Religious aspects--Islam) instead, while existing multiples stay usable until cancelled. H 1090 was revised.
A mausoleum or tomb holding one person is assigned the person heading subdivided by --Tomb; only tombs holding two or more people may be established as headings.
Added to the Military services list (H 1159): --Coxwains.
[Place]--Newspapers is for newspapers with substantive information about the place and is not assigned merely to show place of publication; a general newspaper otherwise gets no subject heading.
Added to the Languages list (H 1154): --Periphrasis.
Request to extend free-floating --Scholia from names of persons to titles of nonfiction works was refused; no precedent for it under nonfiction titles.
Form headings are not assigned to an individual work of fiction (H 1790 sec. 4).

Do not propose strings already covered by an existing multiple subdivision (e.g. Holiness--Judaism, Moderation--Religious aspects--Islam) until the multiples cancellation project finishes; propose only strings not previously authorized by a multiple.
--Translations into English is free-floating under names of literatures (H 1156).
LC keeps the 'long 19th century' dates: Germany--History--1789-1900 and Germany--Politics and government--1789-1900 stay in place of --19th century.
Added to the Animals list (H 1147): --Cadmium content (May Subd Geog).
Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Chemical ecology (May Subd Geog).

Strings based on an existing free-floating multiple subdivision (e.g. English language--Dictionaries--Seminole, Libraries--Special collections--Zines, Sex--Religious aspects--Neopaganism) are used without a proposal until PSD cancels the multiple.
Added to the Animals list (H 1147): --Mercury content (May Subd Geog).
Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Pollination--Climatic factors (May Subd Geog).
Added to the Animals list (H 1147): --Heavy metal content (May Subd Geog).
Added to the Colonies list (H 1149.5): --Intellectual life.
Added to the Literatures list (H 1156): --Lebanese authors.
Added to the Languages list (H 1154): --Recursion.

Existing multiple subdivisions still apply without proposal (e.g. Computers--Religious aspects--Jainism); where no multiple exists propose the string (e.g. Anger--Religious aspects--Methodist Church). Proposals for strings covered by existing multiples will be deleted without comment.
Works on satellites orbiting Earth take Artificial satellites; Artificial satellites--Earth (Planet) and --Orbits were refused.
No separate century heading for a span in the middle of an existing period: Korean poetry--1392-1894 covers the 17th century.
--Religious aspects is not used under classes of persons (Soldiers--Religious aspects refused).
Added to the Names of persons list (H 1110): --Abdication, --Captivity, --Inaugurations, --Kidnapping.

Deleted from the Names of persons list (H 1110): the dated multiple subdivisions --Abdication, [date]; --Captivity, [dates]; --Inauguration; --Kidnapping, [date]; and --Assassination attempt, [date] (covered by --Assassination attempts); replaced by unqualified free-floating subdivisions.
Under [place]--Social conditions, --20th century and --21st century free-float (H 2055); a new span such as Armenia--Social conditions--1991- needs sufficient material, which was lacking.
Playwriting--Collaboration was refused; works on playwrights' collaboration take Authorship--Collaboration with a drama heading or Playwriting.
Regions with directional qualifiers can be established only if well-defined and recognized in English-language reference sources (H 760 sec. 1.e(6)); Wikipedia alone was insufficient.

Chronological subdivisions under --Economic policy are almost always specific significant spans, and H 1110 does not provide centuries there; Portugal--Economic policy--20th/21st century was not accepted without evidence for a particular period.
Mascot headings are in direct order qualified by (Mascot), with inverted UFs and the unsubdivided BT Mascots; corporate names and locations are kept out of the heading.
Single-species headings are discouraged; Pinus oocarpa--Tapping was refused (only Sugar maple--Tapping is retained) and other trees take the species heading plus Tree tapping.
--Fire, [date] free-floats under headings for corporate bodies, buildings and structures, so assign e.g. the theater heading--Fire, 1978 instead of an event heading.
Existing phrase headings for types of museums continue, but new ones are not established; use the free-floating subdivision --Museums with the topic.
--Research is used only for works on how to do research in a field, not for the results of research (H 2020 sec. 2); Linguistics--Research--History--21st century--Congresses was inappropriate.
After linear name changes, Macedonia (Republic) and Swaziland are no longer valid; assign North Macedonia and Eswatini as subject headings and geographic subdivisions.
Free-floating form subdivisions are problematic in linked data, so --Data sets was not authorized; use the genre/form term Data sets.
Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Heavy metal content (May Subd Geog).
No further subdivision under --Seedlings, Container; LC continues that practice and postcoordinates (e.g. Corn--Seedlings, Container with Plants--Winter protection).
Added to the Plants and crops list (H 1180): --Seedlings--Growth (May Subd Geog).
A new open span (Bangladesh--Politics and government--1991- ) should be accompanied by a proposal closing the existing open span, with file maintenance identified for the 1,114 affected records.
[Place]--Literatures is used when one language predominates but several languages of literature exist (H 1828); Polynesia has no predominant language, so Polynesia--Literatures was refused.

As the multiples cancellation proceeds, the continued existence of a multiple subdivision cannot be assumed (e.g. Birth control--Religious aspects--Buddhism, [Christianity, etc.] was cancelled); search LCSH and propose the needed string if the multiple is gone.
General headings for years are assigned only to general works not limited to specific topics (H 620 sec. 2.c); a work on Turkey takes Turkey--History--1918-1960.
Added to the Musical instruments list (H 1161): --Methods (Tangos).
Form headings that merely represent the language are not assigned to individual literary works in a collection (H 1775).
No precedent for author-group subdivisions under inverted headings for minor forms of American literature; assign Lesbians' writings, American with American literature--Hispanic American authors.
When proposing a new open-date span (Montenegro--History--2006- ), consider closing the existing open span (--1992- ) per H 620 sec. 3.d(3).
Individual plays by a single author are not assigned nonspecific form headings (H 1780).

--Pets was not authorized as free-floating under names of persons; works on pets take the person heading, the pet's name heading, and Pets (or a more specific heading). LC is conservative about new free-floating subdivisions, especially under name-authority entities, because of linked data.
Explosions at a plant or building take the corporate or building heading subdivided by --Explosion, [date] (e.g. BASF Aktiengesellschaft--Explosion, 1921), not a separate event heading.
Fires in particular buildings or properties of corporate bodies take the building or body heading subdivided by --Fire, [date] (H 1592 sec. 5.b; H 1105), not a separate event heading.

The 1971- span under Bangladesh--Politics and government was purposely left open when --1991- was established; the proposal to close it as --1971-1991 was refused because the open span remains relevant.
Added to the Literatures list (H 1145): --Anglican authors.

Open chronological subdivisions such as the Heisei period are not closed unless a proposal opens the next period, so proposals for --Heisei period, 1989-2019 should be resubmitted with corresponding proposals for the next period.
--Reviews free-floats under headings for the performing arts, so Concerts--Reviews needed no proposal.
Prime ministers can be subdivided geographically and --Canada is a valid geographic subdivision.
For single-author collections, nationality is expressed only combined with a genre or theme in a phrase heading, and the author's class of persons is not expressed at all (H 1775 sec. 3.b).
Added to the H 1095 list of free-floating subdivisions: --Governorates.

The subdivision --Religious aspects is not used with classes of persons; Kings and rulers--Religious aspects is a practical exception for an old-style heading, not a precedent. Emperors--Religious aspects was not approved and the denominational string was revised to Kings and rulers--Religious aspects--Shinto.

Free-floating --[topic]--Religious aspects strings such as --Civil rights--Religious aspects are deliberately not further subdivided by religion or denomination, so Sexual minorities--Civil rights--Religious aspects--Christianity was not approved. The cataloger may post-coordinate with Civil rights--Religious aspects--Christianity.

Strings such as [place]--Climate--Religious aspects--[religion] were not approved: LC prefers to be conservative about new free-floating subdivisions, especially ones that formerly would have carried multiple subdivisions. Assign Climate--Religious aspects (or Weather--Religious aspects) together with [place]--Climate.

[Place]--Kings and rulers--Religious aspects free-floats but has never been subdivided by religion or Christian denomination, and LC does not wish to begin. Assign [place]--Kings and rulers--Religious aspects and Kings and rulers--Religious aspects--[religion] as two headings.

For a collection of literature by a single author, nationality is expressed only when combined with a genre or theme in a phrase heading, and the author's class of persons is not expressed at all, so this proposal was not necessary.

The term after --Religious aspects must be a religion, not a specific belief or a branch of a religion. Blood--Religious aspects--Nagualism and Brain--Religious aspects--Zen Buddhism were not approved; post-coordinate with the belief heading, or use Brain--Religious aspects--Buddhism.
Mythical animals are established in the name authority file; once established, the name heading may be subdivided by --Art, so a separate Vyala (Mythical animal) in art heading was not approved.

The subdivisions --Estimates and --Counting are established under the general headings Codfish and Codfish populations rather than under headings for specific kinds of codfish, following the earlier Barren ground caribou decision. The proposals for Atlantic cod were revised accordingly.

By policy geographic headings, including headings for streets and roads, are not geographically subdivided (May Subd Geog was not granted). For a work on Highway 93 in Idaho, assign the road heading with Roads--Idaho.

In LCSH the predominant pattern is [Ethnic group]--Music, not [Ethnic group] music; Cajun music is treated as an exception, not a precedent. Creole music was not approved; assign Creoles--Louisiana--Music instead.

LCSH does not establish a heading that pre-coordinates a music genre and a place unless the heading names a specific genre that can be narrowly defined (e.g., Philadelphia soul (Music)). K-pop was added as a UF on Popular music--Korea (South).
Prepositional phrase headings may have up to three elements, but this one is ambiguous, and the practice is to assign two headings, Violence in literature and Women in literature.

Free-floating century subdivisions are used with --Social conditions, and a specific date subdivision is established only where material warrants it. Korea (North)--Social conditions--2011- was not approved; assign Korea (North)--Social conditions--21st century. The same chronological pattern need not be used for every subdivision under a country.
Added to the H 1195 (Land vehicles) list: --Windows and windshields --Defrosters.

Morocco--Politics and government--To 1961 was not approved because it would include all centuries up to 1961. Use the more specific free-floating Morocco--Politics and government--20th century for the protectorate period.

As a general rule headings for types of fictitious characters are not qualified by age, gender, nationality, ethnicity, etc.; assign Teenagers--Fiction and Vampires--Fiction. Lesbian vampires and Lesbian vampires in motion pictures were cancelled on the same principle.
Added to the H 1180 (Plants and crops) list: --Effect of hydrogen sulfide on (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1147 (Animals) list: --Feces --Molecular aspects (May Subd Geog).
Tantrism is a branch of Hinduism, not a religion, so Alchemy--Religious aspects--Tantrism was not approved; use Alchemy--Religious aspects--Hinduism.

The combination --Food --Detection is highly ambiguous (finding food, analyzing digestive contents, or examining feces) and was not approved. Assign separate headings that bring out the specific topics instead.
--Codification is authorized under legal topics per H 1154.5 and may be used under legal systems such as Islamic law; examples were added to H 1154.5 to make this clear.

subdivisions: --Relations with [specific class of persons or ethnic group]
notes.note: Three multiples were deleted from the H 1110 (Names of persons) list. For a person's career, assign the name heading without subdivision plus a heading for the field; for knowledge of a topic use --Knowledge and learning plus a topic heading; for relations with a class or ethnic group assign the name heading plus a heading for the group. --Relations with men/women, --Adversaries, --Contemporaries, --Disciples, --Employees, --Family and --Friends and associates remain valid.
Added to the H 1180 (Plants and crops) list: --Flowering --Molecular aspects; --Odor (May Subd Geog); --Odor --Molecular aspects.
LC does not wish to begin using --Evolution under individual viruses; assign Viruses--Evolution with the heading for the specific virus.
Birds may be subdivided geographically, so works on tropical birds are assigned Birds--Tropics rather than a separate Tropical birds heading.

--Growth is free-floating under organs and regions of the body (H 1164), and --Differentiation is also used under them. Brain--Development and Neurons--Development were not approved; assign --Growth or --Differentiation.

--Morphological aspects does not exist in LCSH and LC does not wish to create it; --Morphology is free-floating under plants and animals. Assign the species heading--Morphology postcoordinated with Regeneration (Biology).
LC does not wish to introduce --Growth--Regulation under individual species; assign [species]--Growth with Microbial growth--Regulation.
The multiple --Views on [specific topic] under William Shakespeare and Abraham Lincoln was cancelled; assign the name heading and an additional heading for the topic, as for other persons.

LCSH has no headings that ascribe an emotion or personality trait to a specific ethnic group or race, and LC does not want to begin the practice; assign headings such as Defensiveness (Psychology), Race awareness, Whites--Attitudes.

The multiples --Characters--Children, [Jews, Physicians, etc.] and --Characters--[name of individual character] were cancelled from H 1110. Assign the literary author's name heading subdivided by --Characters plus an additional heading for the character or group of characters; --Characters remains valid for general works on an author's characters.

The multiples --Religious aspects--Baptists, [Catholic Church, etc.] and --Religious aspects--Buddhism, [Christianity, etc.] (including --Emigration and immigration--Religious aspects-- and --History--Religious aspects-- under places) were removed from LCSH and the pattern lists. Any religion or denomination after --Religious aspects must now be editorially established.

--Swimming was not added to the Animals pattern because it would cause exceptions (the pattern covers land and aquatic animals), and new subdivisions that create exceptions are discouraged. Use --Locomotion postcoordinated with Animal swimming, or a [animal] swimming heading (Dog swimming).
Added to the H 1147 (Animals) list: --Effect of hydrogen sulfide on.
LC does not wish to begin subdividing Event stratigraphy by geologic period (e.g., --Phanerozoic); assign Event stratigraphy with a Geology, Stratigraphic--[period] heading.
Added --Economic aspects (May Subd Geog) to the free-floating lists for animals (H 1147), chemicals (H 1149), diseases (H 1150), plants (H 1180) and land vehicles (H 1195).
--Emancipation has not been used under any subgroup of slaves and LC does not wish to begin; assign Slaves--Emancipation postcoordinated with Child slaves.
Added to the H 1147 (Animals) list: --Chemical ecology (May Subd Geog); --Gastrointestinal system; --Larvae --Chemical ecology (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1156 (Literatures) list: --Haitian influences (May Subd Geog).
LCSH does not include composite (hyphenated) nationality headings for countries other than the United States.
Works on refugees from an individual country are assigned Refugees--[place], not a nationality-qualified heading.
Added to the H 1156 (Literatures) list: --Jaina influences.

Decoration and ornament may be qualified by ethnic group or period (Decoration and ornament, Iban; Decoration and ornament, Medieval); place is brought out with a geographic subdivision. Decoration and ornament, Rwandan was not approved; assign Decoration and ornament--Rwanda. Decoration and ornament, Iranian was revised to Decoration and ornament--Iran.
Geographic features established in LCSH cannot be used as qualifiers for entities established in the name authority file; qualify by the jurisdiction most closely associated with the entity.
--Medicine is authorized under ethnic groups, so the existing Malays (Asian people)--Medicine is assigned instead of a Medicine, Malay heading.
Added to the H 1150 (Diseases) list: $v Code numbers (a form subdivision).
Tombs and mausoleums of individual persons are not established in LCSH because --Tombs is free-floating under names of persons.
Insects--Ecology is a free-floating string established only for hierarchical purposes; per H 370 and H 373, BT and UF references are not made for a free-floating combination established that way.
--Disciples is a subdivision assigned under names of persons; introducing Disciples as the topic in a [topic] in art heading would cause confusion, so Disciples in art was not approved.
Algae--Ecology, Birds--Ecology and Fungi--Ecology are free-floating strings established only as BTs on other headings; no BT or UF references are made for such strings.
The subdivision --Tomb free-floats under names of persons, so a Humayun--Tomb proposal was not necessary; assign the person's name heading subdivided by --Tomb (e.g., Miyan Fahim--Tomb).

Location of a concept is generally expressed by geographic subdivision, not a parenthetical qualifier; the existing Progressivism (Canadian politics) and (United States politics) are unusual. LC questioned whether to keep nationality-qualified headings or use a single Progressivism heading subdivided geographically.

A subject heading is generally not established for an individual trial; use the name headings of the principal parties with --Trials, litigation, etc., unless the trial is known by a popular name other than a party's.
A separate Nara-Narayana in art heading was not approved; assign the appropriate name heading subdivided by --In art.

New [Topic A] and [Topic B] headings are established only when the work treats the relationship from both perspectives in broad terms. A work on Islam's effect on agriculture is assigned Agriculture--Religious aspects--Islam.

For Terrorism the geographic subdivision refers either to the place from which the terrorism originated or where it occurred; Terrorism--Armenia is assigned rather than a Transnational Armenian Terrorism heading.
Added to the H 1147 (Animals) list: --Behavior --Genetic aspects.
Added to the H 1154.5 (Legal topics) list: --Environmental aspects (May Subd Geog).
Added to the H 1156 (Literatures) list: --Maya authors.

Except for Chinese, Japanese and Korean, headings for architectural features are not qualified by narrow time periods; assign the feature heading (Capitals (Architecture)) postcoordinated with a heading for the architectural period.

Musical instruments are identified by country of origin; for the instruments of an ethnic group, assign Musical instruments--[place] plus [ethnic group]--[place]--Music rather than an ethnic-qualified instruments heading.
General headings for centuries, years and other periods are assigned only to general works on the time period not limited to specific topics.

Added to the H 1200 (Wars) list: --Forced removal of civilians (May Subd Geog). It is a distinct concept from --Evacuation of civilians, so the existing --Evacuation of civilians headings were not revised and new headings were created.
On the H 1156 (Literatures) list --Iranian authors was added and --Persian authors was deleted.
Added to the H 1147 (Animals) list: --Nervous system --Physiology (May Subd Geog).
New [Topic A] and [Topic B] headings are proposed only when the work discusses the relationship from both perspectives in broad terms.

Consular jurisdiction was not given geographic subdivision because its BTs are not subdivided geographically and the meaning would be unclear; assign it with Diplomatic and consular service, [nationality]--[place].
Phrase headings for education are established only for broad disciplines; Entrepreneurship is a topic within business, so use Entrepreneurship--Study and teaching.
Added to H 1148 section 4 (Art): $y 19th century.
Added to the H 1159 (Military services) list: --On television.
The adjective Persian qualifies headings that represent language; for nationality, derivation or location use Iranian or the geographic subdivision Iran (Astronomy--Iran).
LCSH has never established headings in the form [topic] in [particular type of museum]; assign Music in museums with Historic house museums.
"in literature" is not appended to a subdivision for an event; assign the building heading--In literature and Sieges in literature as two headings.
H 1105 provides --Fire, [date] under names of buildings and structures, so the work is assigned Grenfell Tower (London, England)--Fire, 2017 rather than an event heading.
--Political aspects can be used free-floating under literatures (English literature--Political aspects is established) although not listed in H 1156; H 1156 and H 1095 will be revised to clarify.

--Security measures is free-floating under individual systems and types of systems, industries and types of industries, and networks and types of networks, so proposals for strings like 5G mobile communication systems--Security measures were not necessary.
The multiple --Discovery and exploration--French, [Spanish, etc.] still covers nationality-specific strings, so Antarctica--Discovery and exploration--Japanese was not necessary.
The heading assigned for Armenian needlework is Needlework--Armenia (place by geographic subdivision), not Needlework, Armenian.
Ethnic folklore may be subdivided geographically, so Ethnic folklore--Azerbaijan did not need a proposal.
H 1105 provides --Fire, [date] under names of buildings and structures; establish the Rhythm Club in the name authority file and subdivide it by --Fire, 1940 rather than creating an event heading.
--Appreciation free-floats under headings for literatures and may be subdivided geographically.

subdivisions: --Computer assisted instruction for French, [Spanish, etc.] speakers
notes.note: Deleted from the H 1154 (Languages) list: --Cognate words--Dutch, [German, etc.]; --Computer assisted instruction for French, [Spanish, etc.] speakers; --Conversation and phrase books--English / French, [Italian, etc.]; and --Study and teaching (Continuing education / Early childhood / Primary / Secondary) for French, [Spanish, etc.] speakers.

Following the 2006 decision, LCSH does not authorize headings ascribing an emotion or personality trait to a race or ethnic group; assign headings such as Race awareness, Blacks--Attitudes, Blacks--Psychology and Pessimism.
Ch'ŏndogyo is a corporate body, so Ch'ŏndogyo--In literature is a free-floating construction and needs no proposal.
General headings for decades, centuries and years are assigned only to general works on the time period not limited to specific topics.
--Massage may be assigned on a free-floating basis under organs and regions of the body.

On the H 1200 (Wars) list --Black people was added and --Blacks deleted. Following special list 2112a, Black people is capitalized throughout LCSH while white people is not unless it is the first word of a heading or subdivision.

Multiples deleted from the H 1154 (Languages) list: --Foreign elements--[language]; --Foreign words and phrases--[language]; --Influence on [language]; --Study and teaching (and its level variants) for [language] speakers; --Translating into [language]; --Transliteration into [language].

Deleted the multiples --Relations--Christianity, [Islam, etc.] from the H 1185 (Religions) list and --Relations--Anglican Communion, [Lutheran Church, etc.], --Buddhism, [Judaism, etc.], --Evangelicalism and --Protestant churches from the H 1187 (Christian denominations) list.
Added to the H 1154 (Languages) list: --Study and teaching (Middle school).
The multiple --Spoken French, [Japanese, etc.] under languages still exists, so Armenian language--Spoken Armenian was not necessary.
The heading was revised to First contact (Anthropology) and the subdivision --First contact with other peoples replaces --First contact with Europeans.
The qualifier Middle Eastern is assigned only to works representing more than one language of the Middle East, not Arabic alone.

Added to the H 1095 list: --In comics, usable under names of persons, families, corporate bodies, places, Christian denominations, uniform titles of sacred works, deities, mythological and legendary figures, and fictitious characters. Uses under wars must be established editorially (World War, 1939-1945--Comics and the war).
The multiple --Spoken [language] still free-floats under languages (H 1154) and the multiples-project instructions are unchanged, so these headings did not need proposals.
--Description and travel is free-floating under names of places (H 1140).
The multiple --Spoken [language] still free-floats under languages (H 1154), so these strings did not need proposals.
New phrase headings for types of museums are not established; --Museums is free-floating under topical headings, so assign Human rights--Museums.
[Topic A] and [Topic B] headings require a reciprocal relationship in broad terms; a work on food words is assigned Food--Terminology, as --Terminology is free-floating under topics.
Gender identity is already a psychological subject (BTs Identity (Psychology) and Sex (Psychology)), so --Psychological aspects is redundant.
A proposal for Diamond mines and mining--Australia--Western Australia had the wrong structure under H 375; the correct heading is Diamond mines and mining--Australia.
Computer systems--Purchasing is a free-floating construction; other Acquisition of [X] headings concern library acquisitions, so Acquisition of computer systems was not approved.

Per established LCSH pattern the heading for forced removal of indigenous children is Indigenous children--United States--Forced removal and internment, 1869-1970, not a standalone Forced removal heading; Sixties Scoop, Canada is the model for references.
--Private collections is a free-floating subdivision under types of objects.
A [topic] and [topic] heading proposal must support the reciprocal relationship between both topics; for press coverage of history, History--Press coverage may be more appropriate.
--Uniforms was not approved as a free-floating subdivision under types of students, because the base term Uniforms already has instructions for use as a subdivision under classes of persons.

A period subdivision such as --Foreign relations, 1830-1848 needs authority research showing a generally recognized period; otherwise use the free-floating 19th century (Latin America--Foreign relations--19th century).

Treble voices is added to the approved free-floating qualifiers for Choruses, so the derivative strings (Unaccompanied, with piano, with orchestra, etc.) free-float and need no proposals; only Choruses, Sacred (Treble voices) was kept as an example.

The standard broader term for nationality-qualified class-of-persons headings is [Class of persons]--United States, so Women illustrators--United States was proposed instead of Women illustrators, American.

Proposals to close the date of the Heisei period (1989-2019) under Japanese fiction, Japanese literature, Japanese poetry, Authors, Japanese, and Japan--History should be submitted together and each must cite a work justifying the change; they were returned for resubmission.

The subdivision --Early life is a UF reference to the free-floating subdivision --Childhood and youth, so Muḥammad, Prophet, -632--Biography--Early life was not approved; use Muḥammad, Prophet, -632--Childhood and youth.
The subdivision --Genealogy is a UF reference to the free-floating subdivision --Family, so Muḥammad, Prophet, -632--Genealogy was not approved; use --Family.
For a work about educational practice, Online social networks--Educational applications was not accepted and the form Online social networks in education was suggested for a new proposal.

Comic books, strips, etc. does not fall under the literature hierarchy and is not a major genre of literature, so author-group subdivisions such as --Jewish authors and --Women authors may not be used under it per H 1156.

Native seeds and Native seeds--Protection were not approved because the topic is covered by existing headings and free-floating subdivisions: Endemic plants--Seeds and Endemic plants--Seeds--Collection and preservation.

--Religious aspects is usually used to indicate that the topic plays some role in the practice of the religion (H 1998); Graphic novels--Religious aspects--Judaism was not necessary and Judaism in comics was suggested instead.

--Law and legislation applies to both domestic and international law, so Islands (International law) is not needed and Islands--Law and legislation should be used; likewise Fishery law and legislation covers both international and domestic fisheries, making the Fishery ... International--Law and legislation proposals unnecessary.
LCSH does not use ethnic qualifiers of the form Leadership, Asian Australian for nations other than the United States.
--Religious aspects applies only to headings with no religious implications; Virtue--Religious aspects--Judaism was not necessary and the headings Virtue and Jewish ethics should be post-coordinated.
The subdivision --Study and teaching (Early childhood) is free-floating under subjects, so Art--Study and teaching (Early childhood) needs no proposal.

Artists' books is now used only for works about books produced by artists as visual art objects; actual specimens of such books are entered under Artists' books--Specimens, following the pattern already established by Miniature books.
Calligraphy, Korean--History and criticism overlaps significantly with the existing Calligraphy, Korean--History; catalogers should use --History.
A specific year heading is not assigned when the work has a topical focus (H 620 sec. 2.c); a work on Germany in 1923 gets Germany--History--1918-1933 instead.

Proposals for new period subdivisions (e.g. Uzbekistan--Intellectual life--1970-1991) need 670 citations showing why the dates were chosen and how they relate to the history or conditions of the place.
LC preferred not to establish a new free-floating subdivision --In video games (proposed as West (U.S.)--In video games); a heading such as Western stories in video games could be considered instead.

Street food vendors, as a class of person, cannot take the free-floating subdivision --Vocational guidance per H 2232, so Street food vendors--Vocational guidance is not a valid string for a vocational guide for street-food businesses.
Deafblind people--Religious aspects--Judaism was not approved; per H 1100 and H 2015.5 the topic receives Deafblind people--Religious life and Jewish way of life.

H 1998 says --Religious aspects applies to works discussing a topic from the religious standpoint, such as its occurrence as a theme in religious beliefs and practices, its importance in doctrine, or the general relationship between the topic and religion; Eggs--Religious aspects--Judaism was doubtful for a work on eggs in synagogue architectural details.
Language and languages--Pronunciation is not used; assign Languages, Modern--Pronunciation instead.
The heading for the law of a people group should be formulated as Law, Čālo, without the parenthetical qualifier of the people-group heading.

For a work about banking in Kyrgyzstan use Banks and banking--Kyrgyzstan, not an ethnic-adjective heading such as Banks and banking, Kyrgyz, which fits only banks or bankers of that group outside the country; likewise Uzbek youth in Uzbekistan is Youth--Uzbekistan.
African clergy is unnecessary per H 350, and Clergy--Africa needs no proposal because Clergy may be subdivided geographically; use Clergy--Africa and Clergy--Europe.
H 760 instructs not to construct regional headings based on islands, so a region heading based on Euboea Island was not approved.
LCSH does not use people groups subdivided by --Wars (e.g. Metis--Wars) as broader terms on headings for wars or battles.
A work about a place on postage stamps is covered by the existing free-floating structure, e.g. Azerbaijan--On postage stamps, so a separate heading was not necessary.
Music headings of the type Benga (Music) are already geographically subdividable, so a proposal to establish Benga (Music)--Nairobi Area (Kenya) was not necessary.

The subdivision --Relations with women is meant to be used only under names of individual persons or groups of literary authors; although free-floating subdivisions can be editorially established under topical headings, Drug dealers--Relationships with women was not approved and post-coordination with Interpersonal relations was advised.

Headings of the form [Topic A] and [Topic B] must show a two-way relationship (H 310); a work on the influence of religion on national security is described by National security--Religious aspects, so Religion and national security was not necessary.

For a work about a particular strike, propose the individual strike as its own heading (H 2100 has instructions for a strike against a single company) rather than Strikes and lockouts--Bicycle industry.
The subdivision --Folklore is free-floating and may be used under ethnic groups without editorial establishment (Uzbeks--Folklore).
The geographic subdivision coding of World music was changed from indirect to no attempt, and the heading was kept rather than changed to Global music.

Per H 1916.3 sec. 3.k, specific performance techniques are expressed as subdivisions under musical instrument headings, so Fingerpicking was not approved as a heading and --Fingerpicking was added to the H 1161 pattern list for musical instruments.

A proposal for a new period subdivision such as Korea--Social life and customs--1637-1864 must give the dates of the period (here the late Chosun Dynasty); see H 620 sec. 3 for establishing period subdivisions.
Merchant mariners is already authorized for geographic subdivision, so Merchant mariners--Africa, West needs no editorial establishment.

Following the existing pattern, when Olympics--Participation is followed by a comma the nationality, not the nation, is used: Olympics--Participation, Chinese, not Olympics--Participation, Hong Kong (China).
--Symbolic aspects was added to the H 1180 pattern list for plants and crops (established under the pattern heading Corn).

Proposals for Comic books, strips, etc. and Comic books, strips, etc.--Film adaptations were withdrawn because a new pattern instruction sheet for comics is being created and they will be reviewed in that wider context.
--Violence against is free-floating under ethnic groups per H 1103, so Indians of North America--Violence against needs no proposal.
--Crimes against and --Violence against are free-floating under classes of persons per H 1100, so they need no proposal under Indigenous children or Indigenous women.

Kola nuts falls within the scope of the H 1180 pattern list for plants and crops, so a subdivision such as --Symbolic aspects is established under the pattern heading Corn and Kola nuts--Symbolic aspects needs no proposal.

Specialized military professions such as --Boiler technicians, --Chaplains and --Flight surgeons are subdivisions on the H 1159 pattern list for military services; a new one should be proposed as a pattern subdivision, or as a subdivision under one branch if unique to it, e.g. United States. Navy--Cryptologic technicians.

LCSH has no precoordinated headings for missing persons, missing children or murder victims under ethnic, national, religious, sexual or gendered classes; works on missing and murdered Indigenous women, girls or persons are assigned several headings, often with --Crimes against and --Violence against under Missing persons, Murder victims, Indigenous women and similar headings.

[Topic] in art is for discussions of the topic as a theme in art works or reproductions of such works; where the cataloged work is itself an artist's book, assign the topic heading with the genre term Artists' books or the subject heading Artists' books--Specimens.

Estonia--Social life and customs--20th century and Estonia--Civilization--20th century can be formed with free-floating subdivisions; considerably more justification is required to establish a specific time period under --Civilization (Estonia--Civilization--1918-1940 was not necessary).
Glass art is a type of fine art and therefore should not use the subdivision --History, so Glass art--China--History and Glass art--China--History--To 221 B.C. were not approved.
A [Topic] in literature heading cannot be built on Human beings--Extinction (not even from its UF reference), so Human extinction in literature was not approved and post-coordination was suggested.
Per H 760 sec. 1.e, a region based on a directional qualifier must be well defined and recognized as such in English-language reference sources; the extent of Nigeria, Northeast was not documented.

Event headings must be for one named event at a discrete point in time and place; several coal miners' strikes over multiple years cannot be grouped into one event heading (Coal Miners' Strike, Batu Arang, Malaysia, 1936-1947) and each identifiable strike needs its own proposal.

H 1148 provides specific period subdivisions for Korean art forms; use Decoration and ornament--Korea--History--To 935 and Sculpture, Korean--To 935 rather than the ancient-art forms Decoration and ornament, Ancient--Korea or Sculpture, Ancient--Korea.

Sterilization of plants to control pests falls under the H 1180 pattern subdivisions for plants and crops, giving Grapefruit--Diseases and pests--Control and Grapefruit--Diseases and pests--Control--Law and legislation; Grapefruit--Sterilization is not needed.
The subdivision --Books and reading (May Subd Geog) is free-floating under classes of persons, so Intellectuals--Books and reading--Brazil needs no proposal.

Per H 1592 sec. 5, events that represent a momentous occurrence in the history of a place are formulated as subdivisions in the form [Place]--History--[Name of event], [date] (e.g. for the Hirak movement in Algeria).

Per H 1156 section II, --White authors and --Male authors are free-floating under any literature or major genre of a literature; use American fiction--White authors or Feminist poetry--Male authors rather than Authors, White or an Authors-style heading.

Headings for river basins use the term watershed; basin is reserved for geological basins (H 800 sec. 9), so Cagayan River Basin was not approved because Cagayan River Watershed (Luzon, Philippines) exists.
Because determining what is a mansion is subjective, use Dwellings--[place] rather than Mansions--[place] for dwellings that may be described as mansions (H 1334 sec. 4.b).

Instead of Goldwork, Silla or Relief (Sculpture), Silla, use the subject arrays Goldwork--Korea--History--To 935 and Relief (Sculpture)--Korea--To 935, each with Silla (Kingdom)--Civilization; the Ancient and Korean form headings were not needed.

Only ethnic groups of the United States and Indian groups take ethnic qualifiers in direct order (H 351 sec. 2.a), and H 350 sec. 1 says not to use adjectival qualifiers for jurisdictions or regions with classes of persons; use geographic subdivision instead, e.g. Motion picture actors and actresses--Arab countries.

Per H 870 sec. 3.a, a geographic subdivision may be interposed between the main heading and a chronological subdivision to represent the music of a place in a certain time, so Popular music--Vietnam--2011-2020 is formed from Popular music--2011-2020 and needs no proposal.
--Rating of is a free-floating subdivision under classes of persons (H 1100), so Translators--Rating of can be used without editorial establishment.

Because these headings may be subdivided geographically, use Dance--Uzbekistan, Marriage customs and rites--Uzbekistan and Wedding dances--Uzbekistan instead of nationality-adjective headings such as Uzbek dance.
The subdivision --Study and teaching is free-floating under names of places, so Korea (South)--Study and teaching needs no proposal.
Legends, qualified by the name of a religion, may be subdivided geographically (H 1627 sec. 2.c), so ethnic-adjective headings such as Oirat legends or Kalmyk legends were not approved.
Region headings with directional qualifiers must meet H 760 sec. 1.e.(6), including citing English-language reference sources and not only the non-English work being cataloged.
Works on the customs of a nationality within its own country can be assigned a heading of the type [place]--Social life and customs, so Uzbeks--Customs and practices was not necessary.

H 1538 gives the instructions for headings for diaries; a patient's diary is assigned strings such as Cancer--Patients--Diaries (not a Cancer patients' writings, Japanese heading), optionally with the genre term Diaries.

Per H 1250 a work on Korean abstract painters gets Painting, Abstract--Korea--20th century--Exhibitions and Painters--Korea (South)--Exhibitions; headings for painters are not based on style, since the art form is what is qualified by the style or movement.

Per H 1592 sec. 4.c, a broader term for a type of event should be a topical heading subdivided by the country where the event occurred; an underground movement is not an event type, so World War, 1939-1945--Underground movements--Malaysia was not approved as a broader term.
Do not establish new [Topic] and state phrase headings; since 1980 the free-floating subdivision --Government policy is used in lieu of such phrase headings (H 1642).

Specialized military professions are entered under the H 1159 pattern subdivisions for military services; a new one may be proposed as a pattern subdivision (see H 1146) or, if unique to a branch, as a subdivision under that branch, e.g. United States. Navy--Cryptologic technicians.
Physics--Study and teaching--Aids and devices was not approved; post-coordinate Physics--Study and teaching with Teaching--Aids and devices.

The free-floating subdivision --Models applies only to select types of subject headings (works on physical or working models); with other base headings the combination must be editorially established, and the work cataloged must show that the LCSH definition of models is represented, which was not shown for Castles, Mosques, Stūpas or Toranas.
There is no precedent for establishing historical eras for individual sports (Deadball Era, 1901-1919 was not approved); assign Baseball--United States--History--20th century.
Established headings such as Children with cerebral palsy--Education and --Home care were deleted because --Education and --Home care are free-floating under classes of persons (H 1100).

Works on the study of a subject are generally assigned headings of the type [topic]--Study and teaching, so Contraception--Study and teaching is used rather than a heading such as Contraceptive education.
LC prefers not to continue the patterns [Topic]--Words for and [Topic], Words for; assign Crusades--History and Language and languages--Etymology instead.
Deaf people--Periodicals was deleted because the form subdivision --Periodicals is free-floating under subjects.

Headings such as Deaf people--Employment, Deaf people--Institutional care and Teachers of deaf people--Economic conditions/--Social conditions were deleted because those subdivisions are free-floating under classes of persons (H 1100).

Separately established chronological subdivisions (e.g. Pakistan--Politics and government--1988-2001 and --2001-) may be proposed only for a generally recognized period shown by authority research or frequently treated in works on the place (H 620 sec. 3.d.2).

Precoordinated headings for psychological concepts in specific classes of persons are established only for men, women, and age groups; assign Body image in men and Sexual minority men--Psychology, since --Psychology is free-floating under classes of persons.
--Copula was added to the H 1154 pattern list for languages.
The free-floating subdivision --In bookplates may be used under countries (H 1140), so Egypt--In bookplates needs no proposal.

Songs of a corporate body are covered by the free-floating subdivision --Songs and music under the name of the body, so use Rotary International--Songs and music rather than a heading such as Rotary songs.
LCSH has no pattern combining a specific element with the phrase in music therapy and PTCP does not wish to start one; use Sound recordings--Therapeutic use together with Music therapy.

General headings for centuries, years and other periods are used only for general works on the time period, not works limited to a specific topic (H 620 sec. 2.c); a work on musical theater in 1924 does not take the year heading.

Because of conflicting and pejorative definitions of Hapa, proposals for --Ethnic identity strings under Asians, Hawaiians, Pacific Islanders and Racially mixed people were not approved; PTCP suggested proposing Hawaiians--Mixed descent for the cited work.

Resources about words considered slurs are assigned the heading for the language subdivided by --Slurs; such strings must be editorially established because --Slurs is not a free-floating subdivision.

Animal sacrifice is inherently religious, so there is no need to establish it editorially with the free-floating subdivision --Religious aspects (e.g. Animal sacrifice--Religious aspects--Islam); Animal sacrifice (Islamic law), Animal sacrifice--Islam or Islam--Customs and practices can be used.

H 1675: the free-floating subdivision --Influence may be used only under names of individual persons and authors, corporate bodies, sects or religions, uniform titles of works, forms and movements in the literary and visual arts, types and individual organizations and individual wars; English literature--Influence was not approved and strings like Short stories, Russian--American influences were suggested.

LCSH has no pattern in which a language heading is subdivided by the literature it influences, and PTCP does not wish to create one, particularly for a free-floating pattern subdivision under all literatures; English literature--Hebrew influences and similar strings remain the form.

The free-floating subdivision --Religious life should be used with classes of persons, so Sexual minorities--Religious aspects--Buddhism was not approved; consider Sexual minorities--Religious life--Southeast Asia post-coordinated with Buddhism--Customs and practices.

A heading limited to sets of objects decorating altars (Altar sets) was not approved. Catalogers should use the heading for the specific denomination subdivided by the free-floating subdivision --Liturgical objects.

Bolivia--History--Wars of Independence, 1809-1825--Campaigns was not approved as a broader term for a battle heading. The correct broader term is Bolivia--History--Wars of Independence, 1809-1825 (see H 1285 Battles).
Beards--Dyeing and bleaching was not approved because Hair--Dyeing and bleaching does not specify the body location. Catalogers may post-coordinate Beards with Hair--Dyeing and bleaching.

The subdivision --Foreign countries and the string --Foreign countries--History and criticism cannot be used under comics and graphic novel headings, because those headings are not qualified by nationality or language.

A new instruction sheet, H 1149.7, governs free-floating subdivisions under genres and forms of comics and graphic novels. Chronological subdivisions under these headings begin with the 15th century (printing press), so proposals for 10th through 14th century were not necessary.

Under H 1647 sec. 2.a, --History may be further subdivided only by chronological subdivisions already established under the topic or place. Palestinian Arabs--Israel--History--Israeli military government, 1948-1966 was not approved because that period is not established under Israel and 1948-1967 already covers it.
There is no precedent for headings of the type [Holiday] parties and starting the pattern is not preferred. Assign Christmas and Parties as two headings instead.

Qualifying Teenagers (ages 13 to 18) or Children (birth through 12) by gender identity, gender expression or sexual orientation is not preferred. Terms from other vocabularies such as Homosaurus may be used with existing LCSH headings through post-coordination.

Adding a national or ethnic adjectival qualifier to a class of persons (Actors, Armenian; Orphans, Armenian; Physicians, Armenian) was not approved. H 350 prescribes [Class of persons]--[Place], and adjectival qualifiers are reserved for certain classes.

Per H 1334, the two broader terms for headings of official residences are Official residences--[place] and [type of head of government or official]--Dwellings--[place]. Palaces--Indonesia was not necessary as a broader term.
Bolivia--History--17th century was not necessary as a broader term because the existing chronological subdivision Bolivia--History--To 1809 applies.
The heading Children's stories, [Language] is assigned to collections of children's fiction under H 1790 sec. 2.c, not to an individual work. Children's stories, Waray was therefore not necessary.
There is no precedent in LCSH for qualifying Popular culture by ethnic or national group, although it may be subdivided geographically. Indigenous popular culture was not approved.
The subdivision --Moroccan authors was added to the H 1156 list of pattern headings for literatures.
The proposal to replace Europe--Civilization--Oriental influences with --Asian influences was withdrawn and retained. The change is being handled in the Oriental headings project.

Adding a national or ethnic adjectival qualifier to a class of persons (Silversmiths, Armenian) was not approved. H 350 prescribes [Class of persons]--[Place] for this, with adjectival qualifiers only for certain classes.

The topical subdivisions --Accreditation and --Evaluation are free-floating and may be assigned under types of institutions, for example Universities and colleges--Accreditation and Education, Higher--Evaluation. A separate heading Accrediting organizations was not necessary.
The string Confectionery--Japan (geographic subdivision of the topical heading) should be used instead of a separate Wagashi heading, and it does not need to be established editorially.
Future life--Slavs--Religion was not approved. Works on this topic are described by post-coordinating Slavs--Religion with Future life.

New LCSH form subdivisions are no longer accepted, so --Logos (e.g. Terrorist organizations--Logos, Gay men--Societies and clubs--Logos) was not approved. Catalogers may propose Logos to LCGFT instead.

Events without a conventional name are expressed by generic headings (H 1560). For Royalist Demonstration, Athens, 1923, the free-floating construction Demonstrations--Greece--Athens is assigned instead.
Per H 620, chronological year headings are assigned only to general works on the time period, not to works limited to specific topics.

Progressivism was established as a heading that subdivides geographically, so qualified headings such as Progressivism (Canadian politics) and Progressivism (Netherlands) and proposed Progressivism--Canada and --United States records were not needed. Progressivism (Canadian politics) was cancelled.

A [Topic A] and [Topic B] heading requires a demonstrated reciprocal relationship between the topics (H 310). Qurʼan and tradition was not approved; Qurʼan--Hermeneutics and Qurʼan--Evidences, authority, etc. were suggested.
Per H 1334 sec. 4.b, do not add the broader term Historic buildings--[place] to a historic building heading. Add a broader term for the type of building instead, such as Dwellings--[place].

Headings for worship of deities, saints, etc. are assigned by adding the free-floating subdivision --Cults to the name of the individual. Sopono (Cult) was cancelled once a name authority was created for the deity Sopono.
The subdivision --Address, Forms of is free-floating under languages, so a proposal for Azerbaijani language--Address, Forms of was not necessary.
The subdivision --Effect of microplastics on was added to the H 1147 list for animals.
The subdivision --Phylogeography was added to the H 1147 list (Animals) and the H 1180 list (Plants and crops).

Updated H 350 sec. D prefers classes of persons with only one or two qualifiers (ethnic, gender, age, religion, etc.). Headings combining three or more qualifiers may not be approved; assign two or more headings instead, e.g. South Asian Americans and Muslim mothers.

Per H 1110, for resources on a person's family, assign the person's name heading from the Name Authority File followed by --Family. A separate family name heading is not created where cultural practice (patronymics, matronymics) precludes surnames.
Under updated H 350 this number of adjectival qualifiers is no longer preferred for classes of persons. Assign African American community activists and Women community activists instead.
Year headings are assigned only to general works on the time period not limited to specific topics (H 620 sec. 2.c); a work on a 1976 strike does not qualify.

A new pattern of the subdivision --Romantic relationships under individual persons and classes of persons was not approved. The existing subdivisions for relationships remain, and the heading Romantic relationships may be post-coordinated.
The subdivision --Flight is free-floating under types of animals, for example Insects--Flight, so separate headings such as Insect flight control were not necessary.
The subdivision --Characters is free-floating under a Name Authority heading for a person, so a separate subject authority record for Ngũgĩ wa Thiongʼo--Characters was deleted.
The heading Universidad Autónoma del Estado de México--Graduate work may be constructed using the free-floating subdivision --Graduate work, so no proposal was needed.
Proposals for strings with --Effect of the Moon on were not approved because other records using the --Effect of ... on subdivision do not carry references for the phrase in direct order.

LCSH limits compound ethnic group headings to those in the United States. Outside the U.S., compound groups are represented by the ethnic group name subdivided by the place where they live (H 1919.5 sec. 1.b).
The subdivision --Effect of herbivores on was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.

Under updated H 350, two or more headings are preferred over a single heading with multiple adjectival qualifiers. Post-coordinate headings such as Doctoral student mothers, East Asian mothers, Student mothers and Women doctoral students.

Europe--Languages and European languages are distinct concepts (geographic vs. linguistic) and are not combined. The new heading European languages follows existing pairs such as Asia--Languages and Oriental languages, and Africa--Languages and African languages.
